arguments.title: Magnolia Terrace | Investment & Offering Memorandum
arguments.subtitle: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

sections.heading: Executive summary
paragraphs: Property: Magnolia Terrace (fictional). Market: Raleigh, NC. Asset: Multifamily. Evaluation date: 2026-08-31.

Certified rent roll supports 44 occupied, 1 pending (not possessed), 3 vacant across 48 suites totaling 40,800 SF. Manager’s headline 45/48 counts pending as leased; we rely on certified possession for occupancy metrics.

Underwriting follows instructions: stabilized gross potential rent from current certified roll monthly schedule × 12, less 5% economic loss, plus $350 annual other income per suite. Operating expenses per T12 plus 3% management. Reserves $300 per suite. NOI before reserves capitalized at 5.75%. Sizing on NCF after reserves with the higher of 6.25% note rate and 6.00% floor (6.25% used).

Resulting metrics: UW EGI $942,480; UW NOI (before reserves) $641,374; UW NCF (after reserves) $626,974; Capitalization value $11.154M. Loan constraints: LTV 65% $7.250M; DSCR 1.25 → $6.789M; Debt yield 9% → $6.966M. Maximum loan $6.789M. Estimated net cash-out after 1% fee + $45k costs and $4.20M payoff: $2.476M.

sections.heading: Property, unit mix and occupancy
paragraphs: Manager mapping: Type A = Studio, Type B = 1BR, Type C = 2BR (manager-cover.pdf p.1). The certified roll (as of 2026-08-31) lists 16 of each type; areas: Studio 700 SF, 1BR 820 SF, 2BR 1,030 SF. Total area 40,800 SF.

Possession status counts on certified roll: Studios 15 active, 1 vacant; 1BR 15 active, 1 vacant; 2BR 14 active, 1 pending, 1 vacant. Therefore 44 occupied, 1 pending, 3 vacant. Unit occupancy 91.67%; area occupancy 91.23% (pending excluded from occupied).

sections.heading: Rent roll and lease analysis
paragraphs: All active leases on the certified roll carry expirations 2029-08-31. Near-term rollover: none within 12 months as of 2026-08-31.

Suite 001 lease is executed at $1,500/mo and 700 SF; a signed amendment effective 2026-08-01 increases monthly rent by $350. The underwriting instruction explicitly uses current certified roll monthly schedule ×12 before Suite 001 amendment for stabilized GPR; the amendment affects only the in-place rent metric, not the stabilized GPR assumption.

sections.heading: Historical vs underwritten financials
paragraphs: Historical trailing-12 (cash basis): collections $876,960; taxes $102,312; insurance $34,104; other recurring opex $136,416; reported NOI $604,128 (operating-statement.pdf p.1). Statement notes roof replacement is capital, with no recurring repair component included.

Underwritten (stabilized per instructions): annual scheduled rent from certified roll ×12 = $974,400; 5% economic loss = $48,720; other income $350 × 48 = $16,800; EGI $942,480. Expenses: taxes $102,312; insurance $34,104; other opex $136,416; management at 3% of EGI $28,274; total opex before reserves $301,106; UW NOI before reserves $641,374. Reserves $300 × 48 = $14,400; UW NCF after reserves $626,974.

sections.heading: Debt sizing and sources & uses
paragraphs: Debt constraints per instructions: LTV 65%; DSCR 1.25; debt yield 9%; 30-year amortization. Note 6.25%, floor 6.00% → sizing at 6.25%. We size on NCF after reserves. Results: LTV limit $7.250M; DSCR limit $6.789M; debt yield limit $6.967M. Maximum loan is the minimum of the three: $6.789M. Origination fee 1% = $67,885. Closing costs $45,000. Existing payoff $4,200,000. Net cash-out estimate $2,475,660.

sections.heading: Risks, caveats and open diligence
paragraphs: Pending counted as leased in manager headline; physical occupancy excludes pending for analysis. Near-term rollover absent: all expirations 2029-08-31. Insurance: policy limit $2,000,000 GL aggregate on 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 declaration; separate from expense.
Capital in opex: statement explicitly says roof replacement was capital (not included), reducing risk of capital leakage in opex based on provided information.

Unsigned rent change: none—amendment is signed; no free rent per Suite 001 lease excerpt. Sizing floor binding: note 6.25% > floor 6.00% → floor not binding. Refinancing shortfall risk absent at sized proceeds relative to payoff; equity is released as shown.
Third-party diligence (legal, environmental, property condition, title) pending but not indicating defects; treat as unresolved pending standard diligence completion.

sections.heading: Source notes
paragraphs: Certified rent roll (as of 2026-08-31) controls for occupancy and rent schedule. A stale June 30, 2026 roll is provided for comparison and shows lower scheduled rents consistent with later increases; do not underwrite from the stale roll.

Historical operating statement is T12 through 2026-08-31; collections are not the same as annualized roll income. Taxes, insurance and other recurring opex from T12 are used directly per instructions plus management at 3% of UW EGI.
Insurance declaration provides policy limit only; it does not opine on adequacy of coverage.
Manager mapping: Type A/B/C = Studio/1BR/2BR; preserve approved copy: "Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence."
